body.prompt: Cinematic film still, photorealistic documentary photography, first-person or over-the-shoulder point of view, moody dark charcoal and deep blue-black color grade with cool bluish screen glow as the main light, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, rich realistic detail, ordinary Korean apartment or office setting. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no readable screens (screens show only soft blurred glow), no watermark, no recognizable faces. Wide 16:9 composition, keep the lower fifth of the frame dark and uncluttered. Scene: Before dawn in a dark bedroom, first-person view looking down at one's own hand holding a smartphone above rumpled grey bedding, the phone screen glowing bright blue-white and lighting the fingers and the edge of the pillow, a bedside table with a glass of water barely visible, everything else in deep shadow.
